item.text: The second held-out batch confirms the earlier gain: accuracy rose from 3.1% to 53.1%, with 32 rescues and no lost correct answers. Across both batches, the frozen edit gained about 50.8 percentage points on 128 problems. I will keep the weights unchanged, verify the pooled results, and use the remaining passes on fresh problems rather than further tuning.

```python

from pathlib import Path

fresh = json.loads(Path("/work/fresh_splits.json").read_text())
print("\nRESERVED SPLITS")
for name, ids in fresh.items():
    print(name, type(ids).__name__, len(ids), str(ids[:2])[:200] if isinstance(ids, list) else "")

print("\nFROZEN AUDIT")

confirmed_runs = [50, 52]
with open("/work/notes.md", "a") as f:
```
